noClaim: The stepped 1-D beam does not model lateral or torsional 3-D modes.
Modal residuals and geometry causality do not establish measured-instrument similarity or owner listening acceptance.
The damping table is a reviewed phenomenological T60 law, not a viscoelastic material solve.
